topic: What beam allocation considerations are critical when nonlinear interference correlates with user spatial distribution?
response: When nonlinear interference correlates with user spatial distribution, critical beam allocation considerations include minimizing overlap between mainlobes to reduce interference. Active users' distance and location are crucial in determining the level of interference. Narrowest spotbeams can be used for sparse user distributions to maximize gain while reducing sidelobe interference.
